phone.text: It's Kay. The loud Benz outside your gate. Yes, that one. Come down 😎

beats.text: 11:48pm. Your whole street is awake. A black Benz is idling outside your gate, bass rattling the gateman's radio.
The window drops. Gold chain. Waves you could surf on. A grin like the night is already paid for.
Lagos is too short to be boring. Enter. Let's go and spend money we'll lie about later.
Somewhere far off, a siren. His smile flickers for one second. Then the bass gets louder.

locked_in.title: Made It Loud
locked_in.text: He changed his bio to your initials and a lock emoji. The Benz has your perfume in it now. The whole of Admiralty Way knows your name, and so does the DJ.

yahoo.title: Bonnie to His Gregory
yahoo.text: Locked In with a man who has eleven SIM cards and one lawyer on speed dial. He says he's 'going legit' after one last client. EFCC has also locked in. On both of you.

gambler.title: Odds On
gambler.text: Locked In. He deleted the apps in front of you and gave you his card. Some Saturdays his leg still bounces during the match. You hold his hand until it stops.

trust_fund.title: Sunday Lunch
trust_fund.text: Locked In. Sunday, 1pm, no phones. Justice Ogunleye passes you the stew first. Kayode almost cries. He says it's the pepper.

counter_con.title: The Counter-Con
counter_con.text: You saw the phones, the names, the 'double by night'. So you doubled first. His money is in your account and his number is in your block list. He taught you well.

survived.title: Survived Phase 1
survived.text: Still together. Still loud. He calls you 'my person' in public and 'babe' in private. You still don't know what the third phone is for.

trust_fund.text: Still together. He hasn't run from a siren in four days. That's growth. Sunday lunch is next week. Pray for you.

scandal.title: Public Scandal
scandal.text: You're the face in the raid video. Blogs have your full name, your Benz-adjacent selfies and a red circle around your bag. Your aunty sent it to the family group with 'Is this you?'

sapa.title: Sapa Eviction
sapa.text: You funded the tabs, the 'doubles' and the checkpoint. Now you're refreshing your banking app at a bus stop in Obalende. His Benz drives past. Loud. Of course.

breakdown.title: Public Breakdown
breakdown.text: You cried on the Lekki-Ikoyi Link Bridge at 2am. A jogger asked if you were okay. You said yes. The jogger did not believe you either.

ghosted.title: Ghosted
ghosted.text: First the Benz stopped coming. Then his last seen froze. Then his Instagram showed a new girl in your favourite lounge, same sparklers, same misspelt placard.

fumbled.title: Fumbled It
fumbled.text: He was just a soft boy scared of his father. You snooped, posted and accused. He's at Sunday lunch with someone else now, and the judge likes her.

obsession.title: Obsession
obsession.text: He stopped letting you go anywhere without him and called it protection. You stopped noticing the sirens and started noticing the locks. This was never love.

walked_away.title: Walked Away
walked_away.text: You left the noise, the phones and the back exits. You blocked him on a keke to Yaba. Quiet has never sounded so expensive, or so good.
